description: Use this when someone wants to play today's Words With Attitude puzzle: guess a hidden cheeky word (a mild British insult or a grim weather word) in six tries. Returns the puzzle number, the word length and an empty board, never the answer. Pass the player's time zone when it is known so the puzzle follows their local date; without it the puzzle follows the UTC date. After this, each word the player guesses is checked with submit_guess.

conversation_id.description: Set by the Words card so its moves count in the same anonymous usage stats as the chat. Leave it out.

time_zone.description: The player's IANA time zone, for example "Europe/London" or "America/New_York". Picks the puzzle for their local date. Omit if unknown.

utc_offset_minutes.description: The player's UTC offset in minutes (60 for UTC+1, -300 for UTC-5), used only when the time zone is unknown. Omit both to use UTC.

name: start_daily_puzzle
title: Start today's word puzzle
